data.name: Ethan's Flag Quiz Game
data.detailed_description:
Test your geography knowledge in this fast-paced quiz game featuring 550+ flags from around the globe. Whether you’re a casual learner, a trivia enthusiast, or a world traveler at heart, this game challenges you to recognize nations by their banners under the pressure of the clock.

🎮 Key Features

  • 🌍 Over 250 Country Flags – covering every corner of the globe.

  • 🌍 US State Flags - Every US State Flag Included!

  • 🍁 Canadian Provinces and Territories - Added based on player feedback!

  • 🐨 Australian States and Territories - Added based on player feedback!

  • 🗾 Japanese Prefectures

  • 🪆 Russian Republics

  • 🏰 German Regional Flags

  • ⚽ Brazilian State Flags

  • 🐯 Malaysian States & Territory Flags

  • 🐂 Spanish Region Flags

  • 🥝 New Zealand Flags

  • 🌵 Mexican State Flags

  • 🍝 Italian Region Flags

  • 🧀 Swiss Canton Flags

  • ⏱️ Timed Challenge – race against the clock to prove your knowledge and improve your reaction time.

  • 📊 Detailed Feedback – at the end of each session, see exactly which flags you missed and discover what to practice next.

  • 🔁 Replayable Learning – sharpen your memory through repeated play and track your progress over time.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Accessible & Family-Friendly – easy to pick up, fun for all ages, and a great way to learn together.

  • 🎵 Simple & Focused – clean visuals and sound effects keep the spotlight on the challenge.

🎯 Who Is This For?

If you enjoy trivia, educational games, or casual brain-teasers, this is the perfect way to test your global awareness and have fun while learning. Whether you’re preparing for a geography exam, challenging your friends, or just curious about the world, this quiz is built for you.

Music Credits

Music featured in Ethan's Flag Games is composed by Kevin MacLeod of and is used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) License.

Trailer Music

  • "Light Thought var 1" by Kevin MacLeod

In-Game Music

  • "Bathed in the Light" by Kevin MacLeod

  • "Autumn Day" by Kevin MacLeod

  • "Meditation Impromptu 01" by Kevin MacLeod

  • "On the Passing of Time" by Kevin MacLeod

  • "Clean Soul" by Kevin MacLeod

All tracks are licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0.

data.short_description: Test your knowledge of over 550 flags in this fast-paced trivia game. Race against the clock, get detailed feedback on what you missed, and improve your geography skills with every playthrough.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster (Intel/AMD)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics or equivalent)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz or faster dual-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 600 series or better)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
